about.label: (01) About
about.title: I'm Iury. I learn by building — and build to learn.
about.lead: Most of what I make starts as a question I can't stop thinking about. This portfolio is where I document what I find.

traits.text: AI is my main material right now — assistants, agents and tools that make information genuinely useful.
I care about how things feel, not only how they work. The interface is part of the solution.
I'd rather ship an honest prototype than polish a guess. Every project teaches something specific.

approach.label: (04) Approach
approach.title: How a question becomes a thing.
approach.note: Five moves, in order — then again. The last step feeds the first.

steps.title: Observe
steps.text: Notice what people actually do, not what they say they do.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: Find the real question under the request.

steps.title: Experiment
steps.text: Build the smallest thing that can prove me wrong.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Turn what survived into something people can use.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: Ship, watch, adjust — and start observing again.
